"""Replay the saved suite launch. Requires MCPJAM_API_URL and MCPJAM_API_KEY."""
import json,time,sys,pathlib
from api import call,ROOT
PROJECT='/projects/project_fixture'
request=json.loads((ROOT/'run-request.json').read_text())
prefix='attempt-'+str(time.time_ns())
status,receipt=call(PROJECT+'/eval-runs','POST',request,prefix+'-launch')
if status!=202:
 print('BLOCKED: no evaluation verdict established. See saved launch response.')
 sys.exit(2)
run=receipt['runId']; path=PROJECT+'/eval-runs/'+run
deadline=time.monotonic()+60
while time.monotonic()<deadline:
 status,detail=call(path,label=prefix+'-status')
 if status!=200:sys.exit(3)
 if detail.get('status') in ('completed','failed','cancelled','timed_out'):break
 time.sleep(2)
else:
 print('Polling deadline reached; inspect saved runId before launching again.');sys.exit(3)
call(path+'/decision-summary',label=prefix+'-decision')
cursor=None; n=0
while True:
 query='?cursor='+__import__('urllib.parse',fromlist=['quote']).quote(cursor,safe='') if cursor else ''
 status,page=call(path+'/iterations'+query,label=prefix+'-iterations-'+str(n))
 if status!=200:break
 for row in page.get('items',[]):
  iteration=row.get('id',row.get('iterationId'))
  if iteration:
   call(path+'/iterations/'+iteration+'/trace',label=prefix+'-trace-'+str(n)+'-'+iteration)
   call(path+'/iterations/'+iteration+'/steps',label=prefix+'-steps-'+str(n)+'-'+iteration)
 cursor=page.get('nextCursor');n+=1
 if not cursor:break
print('Evidence saved under',ROOT,'for run',run)
